items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: Did you ever tell you about him? He was one of the great corner of the head around him. Him and Louis Armstrong used to be like that. They were like brothers.

ctx.x: Well so you basically stopped in 28? 28. That's when you stopped. And then you just played irregularly from then on? That's right.
That's right. I was regularly in 27, 26, all that fun. And then on 19, 19, unless it was Buddy Petit. Did you ever tell you about him? He was one of the great corner of the head around him.

items.title: Eddie Marrero Interview, 1961-10-11
items.q: He started from Buddy. He went with Buddy. Oh, they must have stood together for about twelve years.

ctx.x: Then do you remember who, which bands he played in? Simon we're talking about now. Simon? Sure.

Bands around New Orleans? Yes. Well, he started from Buddy. He went with Buddy. Oh, they must have stood together for about twelve years. And from Buddy, he went to Rene. Kid Rene band. Stayed with them in front of us? He stayed with them all, long time. And he left Rene with Celestan Tuxedo band.
John was with them then too, wasn't he? John was with them then.
